description: The Project for the Development of Playgrounds in Government Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The examination oriented education system driven by the competitive education system and non-availability of adequate infrastructure facilities for sports activities have resulted in causing an unsatisfactory level of participation in sports activities of school students and it is observed that it creates in the promotion of their physical, social and mental well-being. It also affects the identification of outstanding athletes who have the potential to perform at the national and international levels. Since it has been confirmed that, of the 10,096 government schools Island wide, standard sized playgrounds are available only in a limited number of schools which is around 5%, the need to establish at least one standard playground with a 400-meter running track in each education zone, has been identified to ensure equitable access for students in sports. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement the project to develop playgrounds in 400 schools within 4 years, covering all 25 districts, with one national school and 3 provincial schools in each district, at an estimated cost of Rs.2010.50 million, during the period of 2026-2029, was approved by the Cabinet.
